title: ATTN.------DYM.FT.
description: Second diagram on page 53 (BK(NM)-29), paired with (R)INDIV-TD × SOC-RT above. Where the first diagram reaches the reality of attraction through INFO-DS, this one picks up exactly ATTN as subject-axis and crosses it with dynamic-functionalism: ATTN (attraction) crossed with DYM-FT (dynamic functionalism — the partner-axis's working dynamic-functioning). ATTN sits on the right with the subject-arrow; DYM-FT sits at upper-right as partner-axis. AFI (affinity insight) branches from the main line at the top, with SPT-GH (spiritual growth) branching from AFI and AF-TD (affinity tendencies) from SPT-GH. POL-P (political policies) branches from the main line at the center, with CULT-O (culture order) branching from it. AFTF (affinity transfer) runs from the main line to the left, with C-INFO (composite information) and PART (participation) branching from it; EXP-INFO-B (expansion information basis) branches from C-INFO, with AGT (agreement) at the upper-left and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) branching from it, and EXPM (expansionism) from PART.
